description: This file contains unit tests for the EntityTagMatchersValueValidator class, focusing on validation logic for entity tag matchers, including null checks, correctness of input, and class properties.

classes.name: EntityTagMatchersValueValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the validation logic of EntityTagMatchersValueValidator, including constructor immutability, null argument handling, and validation of input strings.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static variables before any tests run, setting a valid entity tag matchers string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test, configuring mocks and the validator instance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the validator class and associated ValueValidator are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullEntityTagMatcherValueValidator
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getInstance throws a NullPointerException with a specific message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that calling accept with a null definition throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as the value to accept throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that a valid entity tag matchers string does not cause any exceptions during acceptance.

methods.name: canValidateEntityTagMatchers
methods.description: Checks that the validator reports it can validate EntityTagMatchers class.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequenceWithSpaces
methods.description: Verifies acceptance of a matchers string with spaces.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotEntityTagMatchers
methods.description: Ensures that the validator does not attempt validation for definitions other than EntityTagMatchers.

methods.name: acceptNonEntityTagMatchersString
methods.description: Tests that an invalid string not representing entity tags causes the expected exception.

methods.name: acceptInvalidEntityTagMatchersString
methods.description: Tests validation failure with an invalid matchers string and confirms the presence of an expected URI in the exception.
